<div class="card-body">
'''Dark Hours''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">暗黒の刻</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">“夜間状態”の位置を1つ選ぶ。その場にいるドロイド以外のキャラクターすべてを対象とする。各対象につき1枚ずつ運命数を引く。運命数＞能力値ならば、そのキャラクターは睡眠状態になる。睡眠状態のキャラクターは、戦闘力、能力値、没収値がいずれも0になり、次のこちら側のターンの終了時まで、カードルールを適用できなくなる。それが終わればこのカードはキャンセルされる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-212o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍の襲撃と監禁、尋問ドロイドやターキンによる自白の強要を耐え抜いた後、レイア姫は助けがくるまで深い眠りに落ちた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Dark Hours.

'''Card text:''' Choose one site under nighttime conditions. Target each non-droid character there. Draw destiny for each. If destiny > ability, that character sleeps. A sleeping character has power, ability, and forfeit 0, and may not use card rules until the end of your next turn. This card is then canceled.

'''Lore:''' After Imperial assault, captivity, an interrogator droid, and Tarkin's demands for a confession, Princess Leia fell into a deep sleep until help came.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese cancels card rules until the end of the next turn; the English also cancels piloting, driving, and moving.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Dark Hours]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
